Work Experience

Graphic Designer

Tjek · 2025 – present · almost 1 year and 6 months

Designing digital catalogues for retailers across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland, from weekly offers to large seasonal releases.

What I do

  • Template design in the Incito 3.0 designer. I build front pages, section headers, offer designs, frames and outros in the catalogue CMS.
  • Feed-driven layouts. I connect designs to retailers’ product feeds and map fields like price, product name, badges and environment images.
  • Offer grids and overflow. I set up grids that fill automatically and size prices with Smart Size, so no page shows an empty slot or a cut-off price.
  • Seasonal themes and animation. I create Christmas, Halloween and campaign versions from a client’s palette, with animations that add atmosphere.
  • Section management. I generate and refill sections, assign templates and cohorts, and keep manual image fixes and product order intact after feed updates.
  • Multi-country rollouts. I copy approved designs between accounts and switch them to Danish, Swedish, Norwegian or Finnish feeds.
  • Incito 3.0 migrations. I move existing clients’ catalogues from the old setup to the new designer.
  • Quality checks. I review every catalogue in Preview and handle client feedback through Linear tickets.

What I’ve achieved

  • Client standards. My offer design for Coolshop’s Christmas catalogue became the standard template for all of their catalogues.
  • Big launches on time. I delivered Coolshop’s 60+ page Christmas toy catalogue, their largest release of the year, for its October launch.
  • New client onboarding. I designed the first digital catalogues for Coolshop and Lekia, translating their print style into reusable templates.
  • Reusable systems. Templates I build can be reused across campaigns, so new catalogues are faster to produce.
  • Platform upgrades. I helped move Coop (Kvickly, SuperBrugsen, Brugsen) and Rafha to Incito 3.0.
  • Sales support. I designed demo catalogues for prospects such as Intersport Norway and Happy Homes Sweden.
  • Problem solving. I find workarounds for designer limitations and fix issues like blurry images and unreadable text over photos.

Clients I’ve designed for

Coolshop · Lekia · Coop DK (Kvickly, SuperBrugsen, Brugsen) · Nille · Byggmax · Nemlig · City Gross · Rafha · Din Tøjmand and MR · Build-A-Bear · Vøruhúsið · Wolt · Intersport · Happy Homes · and more
